::: {#exm-contradiction-works}
#### The six and nine proof, read through the theorem

In @sol-six-nine,
$P$ is "there are no integers $m$ and $n$ with $6m + 9n = 1$",
and $C$ is "$3 \mid 1$".
The solution assumed $\neg P$, that such integers exist,
and derived both $C$ and $\neg C$.
That proves $\neg P \Rightarrow (C \land \neg C)$,
so, by @thm-contradiction-works, it proves $P$.

:::
